finding.claim: POST /profile/avatar fetches a user-supplied URL server-side. The only check is that the string starts with "https://". There is no host or IP allowlist, no private, loopback or link-local blocking, and no DNS pinning. axios also follows redirects by default (up to 5). An attacker can point the server at internal HTTPS services or a cloud metadata endpoint, or at an attacker host that redirects to an internal target. The response is not returned, but the bytes length is, which gives a blind oracle for reachability and response size. Any internal service that answers on HTTPS or via a redirect is reachable. The route has no auth guard.

trace.note: Only checks typeof string and startsWith("https://"); host is not validated, so https://169.254.169.254/, https://internal-host/ and https://localhost/ all pass
axios.get(url) with default maxRedirects=5 and no host or IP restriction, so redirects to internal targets are followed
Response size is returned to the caller (res.json({bytes: img.data.length})), a blind oracle

finding.guards_checked: Scheme prefix check only (startsWith https://). No parsed-host allowlist, no private/loopback/metadata IP block, no DNS-rebinding protection, no redirect restriction (maxRedirects default), no auth middleware. express.json only parses the body. The second route (GET /users/:id) was also checked and not reported. Its host is a constant (USER_SVC) and the id goes through encodeURIComponent, so the request cannot leave users.internal. The only residual issue is that a '..' id is not encoded, which allows traversal within that same internal service, not SSRF to another host.

verdict.guard_found: Scheme-only check: typeof string and startsWith("https://") at server.js:11. There is no host or IP validation, no auth middleware and no redirect restriction.
verdict.reason: server.js:10 takes req.body.avatarUrl from an unauthenticated POST, and server.js:11 only checks the "https://" prefix, so server.js:14 axios.get fetches any host (and follows redirects), with the byte length returned at server.js:15.
